brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate efficacy and safety of coadministered Irbesartan and Atorvastatin in patients with hypertension and hyperlipidemia.
brief_title: Efficacy and Safety of Irbesartan and Atorvastatin in Hypertension and Hyperlipidemia

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged between 19 and 75 years
* Signed informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* At screening, SPB ≥ 180mmHg or DBP ≥ 110mmHg or LDL-C \> 250mg/dL or TG ≥ 400mg/dL
* Has a history of hypersensitivity to Angiotensin Ⅱ receptor blocker or HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor or component of this drug
* Has a history of multi-drug allergy

official_title: Efficacy and Safety of Coadministered Irbesartan and Atorvastatin in Patients With Hypertension and Hyperlipidemia

primary_outcomes.measure: Percent change from baseline to 8 week in LDL-Cholesterol
Change from baseline to 8 week in Blood Pressure.

sites.facility: 16 institutions including Seoul National University Hospital
